title: Student Grade Manager reference design

architecture: Keep main responsible for orchestration, not all program logic.
Make ownership and resource cleanup rules explicit.
Return status values and preserve diagnostic context.
testing_guidance: Compile with explicit standard and warnings.
Run normal, boundary and malformed-input cases.
Record compiler/OS/version and any unsupported features.
solution_outline.limitations: This is a reference design outline, not a complete tested production application. Extend only after reviewing requirements and target-platform constraints.

explanation: Assess this project against the published rubric; alternative architectures are valid if they meet the contract and are tested.
